summary:
Three of the five proposals adopted, two rejected on evidence; all edits made in the Phase-1 slices and both assemblers re-run.

A — SKILLS. Adopted 重型机械→机械 and 远程战斗→射击, both derived from the ch.3 skill descriptions rather than the English word forms, and both reversing a level-1 source (recorded as new rulings R5/R6 with the exception they invoke and its limit). REJECTED 通讯 and re-affirmed R3's 通信科技: the description writes 'computer **or** communications technology' in coordination and opens with 'Programming androids, mainframes' — the computer side — so 通讯 keeps only the lesser half and is strictly worse than 计算机科学, the candidate R3 had already rejected. Result: 11 of 12 skill names at 2 chars with one justified 4-char outlier, down from three. R3 now records the challenge, the verdict, the new evidence, and where the width cost was paid instead.

B — INVENTORY. maxrng 最远射程→射程: the collision with ALIENRPG.Range is desirable, because the two keys already label the SAME lCol15 column in two registered skins of one sheet (crtui and vehicle inventories were already 射程) and bind the SAME field system.attributes.range.value on item-weapon.hbs in mutually exclusive branches — they can never appear together; and character-inventory.hbs:28 sits outside the isEvolved guard, so core-ruleset players were reading an Evolved-only qualifier. Water 水→饮水: a full sweep of every grid cell in every live template found it to be the only per-column length outlier in the whole sheet set (伤害/水/空气 stacked in one column; 空气/食物/水/电力 in the consumables block). REJECTED 电量 for Pwr: the button under that header is data-spbutt="Power" and _onRollSupply builds its label from ALIENRPG.Power, so the two keys must share one Chinese string — and ALIENRPG.Power is also the item CATEGORY name at config.mjs:520 where 电量 would be wrong. The owner's 'unclear' came from the row, not the word; fixing 水 fixes it. Sweep went from 6 outliers to 2, both reported.

C — CRIT CARD. REJECTED 疗程 and kept 治愈时间, exactly on the test the brief asked for: the crit table's HEALING TIME column contains **Permanent** (2 rows) plus empty→None, and 疗程 is a bounded course of treatment, so 「疗程：永久」 is a contradiction. Every 2-char alternative in the heal/recover family inverts the same way, and the two neutral head characters are already spent by siblings (时限 blocks 时*, 伤势 blocks 伤*). These are five stacked <h4> lines, not fixed-width columns, so the 4-char label costs 2 characters of offset on one line.

Along the way I found and fixed a live lockstep break the smoke test would eventually have hit: the shipped pack still carried the old item names while lang carried the new ones, so two stunt buttons were pointing at nothing. Both artefacts are now verified byte-equal end-to-end. The glossary leg of the lockstep is updated at its input (RULINGS.json, proven to apply) but cannot be regenerated — build_glossary_v1.py has been failing at baseline on 9 unrelated T-FROZEN entries.
